answer: The ripple detector writes each match to the horizon queue, and the onyx checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. A submitter whose answers share 6 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 23% of its pending payouts meanwhile. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
